issues.description: The Course.addRating(stars:) method has a return type mismatch across artifacts. The template declares addRating(stars:) with no return value (Void) in Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift, while the solution implements addRating(stars:) -> Bool. The problem statement describes the behavior to validate and add a rating but does not specify a return type. This inconsistency can confuse students about whether they should return a Bool indicating success or nothing, and may cause tests or reference solutions to differ from students' implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected signature explicit and consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Update the template method signature to match the solution (func addRating(stars: Int) -> Bool) and update the problem statement to mention the Bool return indicating success/failure; or (B) Change the solution to use a Void return to match the current template and clarify the problem statement to state no return value is required. Choose one approach so the template, problem statement, and solution agree.
